sequence_key: Copula → Noun → Particle → Noun → Topic Marker → Adjective → Auxiliary

japanese: はい、この地域では基本的に皆さん加入していますよ。

english: Yes, basically everyone in this area joins.

grammar_function: Time, Aspect & State (〜ている / 〜てある)
sequence_key: Interjection → Pronoun → Noun → Particle → Adverb → Noun → Verb → Particle

japanese: すみません、隣の部屋の騒音についてお電話しました。

english: Excuse me, I am calling regarding the noise from the room next door.

sequence_key: Interjection → Noun → Particle → Noun → Particle → Noun → Particle → Verb

english: Yes, the footsteps are quite bothersome, so could you please tell them to be careful?

sequence_key: Interjection → Noun → Subject Marker → Adverb → Verb → Conjunction → Verb → Request

japanese: わかりました。すぐに相手の部屋に通知を送ります。

english: I understand. I will send a notice to the other room immediately.

sequence_key: Verb → Adverb → Noun → Particle → Noun → Particle → Noun → Direct Object Marker → Verb

grammar_explanation: The particle 'wa' marks the topic of the sentence, introducing what is being discussed.
grammar_function: Copula, Topics & Definitions (です / は / について)
sequence_key: Noun → Particle → Noun → Particle → Noun → Topic Marker → Adverb → Adjective → Copula → Particle
